verdict.rationale: Logseq is a local-first, open-source app that stores data as local markdown/EDN files on the user's own machine, with no mandatory cloud dependency; it's the core self-hostable product by design, with local HTTP API server for programmatic/AI access. missing for 10: no explicit self-hosted server/multi-user deployment docs (it's single-user local storage, not a hosted server model), and no independent audit of self-hosting robustness beyond community sync/performance complaints.
